summary: The Levites are to possess their own cities—Cities of refuge are established for those guilty of manslaughter—Murderers are to be executed by the revenger of blood.
meta_description: The Levites are to possess their own cities—Cities of refuge are established for those guilty of manslaughter—Murderers are to be executed by the revenger of blood.

footnotes.note2_b: IE open areas for fields and pasture (also vv. 3–7). Lev. 25:34 (32–34); Josh. 14:4; 2 Chr. 11:14; Ezek. 48:15 (15–17).
footnotes.note33_b: HEB atonement cannot be made for blood shed in the land except by the blood of him who shed it. TG Accountability.
